sources.title: OWASP Application Security Verification Standard 5.0.0 (JSON release)

control_flags.level: The lowest ASVS level that includes the requirement (1, 2 or 3). Levels are cumulative.
control_flags.section: The ASVS section the requirement belongs to (V1.1), with section_name.

scoring.summary: Percentage of applicable Level 3 requirements that are verified. ASVS defines no score; an application meets Level 3 only when every applicable requirement at that level is verified, and this percentage is an HCG measure of progress toward that.

rules.summary: Level 3 is for applications whose compromise would cause critical harm, such as those handling high-value transactions or sensitive health data: every requirement in the standard.
A requirement belongs to every level from the one it names upward; this Level 3 assessment holds 345 requirements.
A requirement for a feature the application does not have (for example WebRTC, OAuth or file upload) is marked not applicable rather than failed.

glossary.definition: The OWASP Application Security Verification Standard, a list of security requirements for designing, building and testing web applications and services.
The Open Worldwide Application Security Project, a nonprofit foundation that publishes open application security standards and tools.
One of three cumulative ASVS levels that set how many requirements apply, chosen by the risk the application carries.
